sources.snippet: Download Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct for free. Powerful 14B LLM with strong instruction and long-text handling. Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct is a powerful instruction-tuned language model developed by the Qwen team, based on the Qwen2.5 architecture. It features 14.7 billion parameters and is optimized for tasks like dialogue, long-form generation, and structured output.
